items.html: And this is what is said: 'they illuminate and sparkle with the radiance of the upper wisdom.' And just as there is in the lower Yesod nine from above downward and nine from below upward, so too in the secret of the Daat, which separates between Arich Anpin and ZA, there are these. And this is what is said in the Zohar: 'the radiance and sparkle of the river that goes out of Eden,' which is the secret of the Daat, which goes out of the upper Eden and enters the brain of ZA; and in this Daat there is radiance and sparkle, as I explained.
